summary: Deduplicated discussion-sourced signals: policy/regulatory hit on DeepSeek, multiple security/ops reports (OpenCode key leak, EUVD RCE), sandbox/runtime evolution, and operator workflow anecdotes about agents leaking or mis-scoping access. | Compressed set of official-vendor signals: product releases (MS, AWS, Cloudflare), security GHSA advisories for agent infra libraries, vendor guides for self-hosting and IDE integration, and sandbox/secret-handling infra updates. | Headlines from GitHub OSS: Vercel and Microsoft agent tooling updates, major MCP/sandbox releases, and several high‑traction agent frameworks; missing social/operator reports for field workflows. | Packages snapshot: heavy VS Code agent ecosystem (OpenAI, Nexrall, AbacusAI), Amazon ECS agent presence, and a set of emerging infra primitives for agent sandboxes, memory, and eval. No social/operator reports in this shard — follow-up needed for user-workflow signals and corroboration for many single-repo packages.
